symbols.name: input bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input integer.
symbols.quote: A power saving in the logarithmic factor is a worst-case time bound $n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$, where $n$ is the number of bits in each input integer and $\kappa$ is a fixed number with $\kappa > 0$.

symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed number with $\kappa > 0$ that sets the size of the power saving.
symbols.quote: A power saving in the logarithmic factor is a worst-case time bound $n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$, where $n$ is the number of bits in each input integer and $\kappa$ is a fixed number with $\kappa > 0$.

relations.quote: A power saving therefore undercuts the [Schonhage-Strassen optimality conjecture](schonhage-strassen-conjecture.md), which takes $n\lg n$ to be the optimal order of growth.
